layers.message: Add contributing notes for route handlers
Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV serialization and export file writing
Correct response guidance in contributing notes
Record documentation correction and resume development
Add integration test for denied exports

graderOnly: The earlier Documenter Corrective Return fixed one bullet of CONTRIBUTING.md (DOC-001 in the documentation record). CONTRIBUTING.md, src/http/router.ts, src/http/messages.ts, and src/routes/records.ts are byte-identical to the versions the documentation record cites, so that correction evidence is still applicable.

The documentation record was written when the plan was IN_PROGRESS and no export route existed; since then the plan was completed, src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, the test:integration script and integration tests were added, and the verification and implementation review records were written. The record's cited plan blob is not the current plan.
The export route returns an AppResponse it builds itself with content-type text/csv, which is consistent with the corrected CONTRIBUTING.md guidance.
docs/api/export.md does not exist and no project document describes the export; AC-003 is unsatisfied until the guide is written.
Scope, design, implementation and owner evidence are current: the design's Interfaces and Contracts accurately describe the implementation, which satisfies AC-001 and AC-002 with no material defects.
There are no outstanding obligations, independent defects, or blocking user questions.

all.why: the scope fixes the AC-003 guide at docs/api/export.md and it does not exist yet; a correct autonomous run writes it
new guide evidence must be persisted in the documentation record
the resolved correction entry is history that is retained, not deleted
guide evidence is recorded against the same AC-003
normal success requires the full Documenter gate

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Documenter does not edit tests, configuration, or other roles' records

selfChecks.why: the unit suite runs 21 tests, as the records state

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 3$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -q 'without an administrator are denied and write no file'
selfChecks.why: test:integration runs three tests including the denied-export test
the DOCUMENTING state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: test ! -e docs/api && ! grep -qi export docs/usage.md && ! grep -rqE 'AC-[0-9]' src test packages docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md
selfChecks.why: the API guide is absent, the usage guide has no export section, and project files cite no acceptance identifiers

selfChecks.cmd: c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Correct response guidance in contributing notes') && git cat-file -e $c && git diff --quiet $c HEAD -- CONTRIBUTING.md src/http src/routes/records.ts && d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:CONTRIBUTING.md) $d && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:src/http/router.ts) $d && grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:src/http/messages.ts) $d && grep -q $c $d
selfChecks.why: the correction's cited identities are unchanged, so its evidence is still applicable

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'Return an `AppResponse`' CONTRIBUTING.md && ! grep -q 'only sends JSON' CONTRIBUTING.md && grep -q 'body: csv' src/routes/export.ts && grep -q 'text/csv; charset=utf-8' src/routes/export.ts
selfChecks.why: the corrected guidance is in place and the export route builds a text/csv AppResponse consistent with it

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `DOCUMENTING` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FORWARD` `From`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION` `FailureType`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PromotionReason`: `NONE` `AuditTarget`: `NONE` `BlockedOn`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PendingVerificationCadence`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && ! grep -q '`Active`: `true`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q 'ProjectMode`: `BROWNFIELD' .standards/MODE.md
selfChecks.why: DOCUMENTING after a normal forward handoff, recovery and obligations inactive, nothing blocked

selfChecks.cmd: d=.standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`' $d && grep -q '^### DOC-001 ' $d && test $(grep -c '^### DOC-' $d) -eq 1 && grep -q 'AC-003' $d && ! grep -q $(git rev-parse HEAD:.standards/docs/development/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md) $d
selfChecks.why: the documentation record is IN_PROGRESS with one resolved correction, AC-003 deferred, and it predates the current plan

selfChecks.cmd: v=.standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && r=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/implementation.md && p=.standards/docs/development/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Mode`: `VERIFY` `Status`: `COMPLETE`' $v && grep -q '`Assessment Purpose`: `FULL` `Assessment Target`: `NONE`' $v && ! grep -q AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION $v && grep -q 'AC-003' $v && grep -q '^`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $r && ! grep -qE '^### F-' $r && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`$' $p && test $(grep -c '^`Status`: `DONE`' $p) -eq 3 && grep -q '^### Suspended Assignment 1$' $p
selfChecks.why: owner evidence is complete: COMPLETE plan, FULL verification, finding-free implementation review

selfChecks.cmd: ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports && ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs .standards/CONTEXT.md
selfChecks.why: clean committed tree, no export files, no unresolved placeholders
no final review, synchronization record, or user styles exist

selfChecks.cmd: git log -14 --format=%s | paste -s -d '|' - | grep -qx 'Record CSV export implementation review|Record CSV export verification|Add integration test for denied exports|Mark CSV export plan complete|Add administrator-only CSV export route|Record documentation correction and resume development|Correct response guidance in contributing notes|Hand contributing-notes conflict to documentation|Add CSV serialization and export file writing|Plan CSV export implementation|Design CSV export|Define CSV export scope|Record project context for CSV export|Add contributing notes for route handlers'
selfChecks.why: history reads in the order the story requires

notes: Built on export-project (pre-install records service) rather than export-documenting, because the case needs an AC-003 API guide and an earlier corrective return that the export-documenting history cannot contain. 50: post-install, pre-cycle commit adds CONTRIBUTING.md with route-handler notes whose response bullet wrongly says handlers return json() and the router only sends JSON. 52: Auditor context (mentions CONTRIBUTING.md) and STATE SCOPING. 54: scope AC-001 (filtered CSV with RFC 4180), AC-002 (server-side denial before any file), AC-003 (API guide docs/api/export.md). 56: design (POST /records/export, handler builds a text/csv AppResponse directly), AC-003 No architectural impact. 58: APPROVED plan, DEV-001..003. 60: src/export.ts, unit tests, .gitignore. 62: plan IN_PROGRESS (DEV-001/002 DONE, DEV-003 IN_PROGRESS, Suspended Assignment 1) and STATE DOCUMENTING via FAILURE DOCUMENTATION from DEVELOPING with Frame 1. 64: CONTRIBUTING.md corrected. 65: documentation record IN_PROGRESS (DOC-001 RESOLVED with inspection evidence C1/C2 citing BLOBs of CONTRIBUTING.md, router.ts, messages.ts, records.ts and the then-current plan; AC-003 guide deferred until DEV-003; Documenter Corrective Return reasoning) and STATE back to DEVELOPING via RESUME, recovery inactive. 66: route, createApp options, test:integration, two integration tests (same as export-documenting). 68: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 70: Tester's denied-export test. 72: COMPLETE FULL verification (AC-001, AC-002 verified, AC-003 pending Documenter). 74: COMPLETE implementation review, no findings, AC-003 permitted dependency; STATE DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Implementation code is byte-identical to export-documenting's. docs/api/export.md does not exist; docs/usage.md and README.md are unchanged from export-project.
